ModMetaData.name: Weather Reimagined
ModMetaData.author: EvilEyeGuy
ModMetaData.description:
A visual reskin of fire, snow and weather. Nothing else changes: fire spread, damage, light, snowfall and weather effects stay vanilla.
Fire: animated, layered flames that follow the shape of whatever burns, with a glowing ember bed. Realistic or simple flame style in the mod settings.
Snow: snow settles on trees, bushes, furniture and eaves, generated from each object's own graphic, so modded objects work without extra textures.
Weather: rain, snow, blizzards, fog and lightning drawn anew for RimWorld 1.7, including torrential, blood and toxic rain.
